references.title: Phagemid pSIT permits efficient in vitro mutagenesis and tightly controlled expression in E. coli.

label: T7 g10 leader
note: T7 gene-10 (g10) translational leader / RBS: epsilon enhancer + Shine-Dalgarno (AAGGAG) + spacer; drives strong translation in the T7 expression system. Extracted from pET-28a (Addgene 249430), the RBS/leader between the XbaI site and the start ATG (35 bp). DNA 5'UTR element, distinct from the T7-tag peptide (see T7_tag).

provenance.sequence_source: U17139 (phagemid cloning vector pSIT; Andreansky & Hunter 1994) 72..106, identical over 35 bp; the oldest of 608 exact deposits. It is the pET-vector form of the T7 gene 10 leader (Studier et al. 1990, cited by the record), ending ATATACC before the vector's start codon.
